A.name: Ground truth provenance
details: 713 externally supplied annotation files (245 LasHeR, 468 RGBT234) match the recorded inventory and held rgbt package bytes. GT is not derived from any audited prediction. All evaluated frames and sequence names match the two benchmark inventories.

1,967 actually held package files match the post-evaluation installed manifest; all 3,556 installed-manifest hashes match members of the held rgbt 1.0.1 wheel. The other 1,589 installed copies were not independently possessed/read. Wheel correspondence is distinct from author-toolbox or SCDT equivalence.

The full package/GT/mask collection seal is post-evaluation. evaluate_model.prepare contains mask and GT hash assertions against the earlier inventory before inference, but this is not an independently captured full installed-package startup seal.

The supplemental split archive contains train 882/val 97; they are pairwise name-disjoint from Test 245 and match current split bytes. Its recorded observation is 3,894.443616 seconds before FT launch. Split texts and training annotations are absent from the FT launch hash manifest; historical original-E0 exposure is not certified.

B.name: Score normalization and reconstruction
details: Independent reviewer formulas reproduce all 10 FT metrics and 93,966 curve cells exactly. Both baselines add 20 metrics and 187,932 cells, also exact. Maximum absolute metric difference is 0 pp and maximum curve-cell difference is 0.
No denominator uses the model output maximum, mean or minimum. NPR normalizes centers using GT width/height plus 1e-8. RGBT234 min center error/max IoU select between two external GT annotations.

Preserved float32 loading and ties-to-even prediction rounding, LasHeR GT rounding and first-frame replacement, all-frame denominators, inclusive pixel geometry, PR/MPR<=20, NPR<=0.20, strict IoU>threshold, 21-point arithmetic success average, and equal weighting over sequences.

LasHeR has 1,260 nonpositive-coordinate GT frames in 52 sequences. Setting error/IoU to-1 makes PR/NPR count them as successes and SR as failures; contribution relative to same-denominator failures is0.5568053864558151 pp. This is disclosed scorer behavior, not learned performance. RGBT234 has 596 visible+633 infrared such rows in 14 sequences, all with positive sizes; MPR/MSR do not apply the LasHeR invalid-GT override.

C.name: Results, completion, checkpoints and numbers
details: FT raw archive payload list has 2,064 files plus collection.json. All payload hashes,958 bbox/individual receipt pairs,674,706 finite rows,479 DONE entries per evaluation, all_receipts records and terminal exit0 records agree. Each evaluation covers479 sequences/337,353 frames; first raw box equals visible/LasHeR initialization GT in all 958 runs.

Exactly 50,000 sequential updates,2,500 per epoch 1..20; finite numeric fields, monotonic elapsed time and 2,001 printed training records cross-match steps.jsonl. Config, completed records, run hashes and fixed epoch 20 metadata agree. Report JSON, CSV and all 10 Markdown table rows match source metrics and both baselines;20 deltas are correct.

Both evaluation runs cite final checkpoint SHA 0f276f65f360e8a744a76ae0f32bba2f41bbc62e8956b59c883e6f87485c57a8. The collector code and successful actual transport support parent CPU SHA/strict-load/finite-state/BN metadata. The sealed tracker/README/handoff describe the earlier04:24 evaluation-running snapshot. They are historical snapshots, not phantom-result evidence; current publication should update status after this audit while preserving sealed bytes.

D.name: Executed versus inactive paths
details: Recorded launch argv and corresponding exit/log/receipt files bind the formal entry to miss_rgbt.train then evaluate_model.py for complete and miss. In FT, train.py89-92 executes only complete model + dataset task loss; sample_masks and training_loss/KD/repair paths are inactive. stage config has repair=false and both KD weights0.

All primary metric methods are reached by the dataset calls at evaluate_model.py141-149 and yield the saved curves. Generic PR/SR, GTOT metrics and plotting/attribute code are not used for the reported five metrics; no dormant metric output is represented as a formal result.

Campaign/source collection115, training92, and each evaluator106 source/config hashes match frozen held bytes. Both availability evaluations share all 106 executed source hashes with FT; original E0 manifests have87/87 common entries equal to the held FT baseline source.

Both-missing frames bypass track and hold exactly in 52,493 non-first FT Miss frames. MissingTracker zeros unavailable embeddings and carries historical template availability; original E0 duplicates an available image without that explicit flag path. Thus Miss training effects should use the availability baseline. Full complete E0/availability metrics are identical; only 254/479 raw trajectories are array-identical, max coordinate difference2.6147972675971687e-12.

E.name: Scope, budget, development boundary and causal claims
details: One fixed seed 2027, one fixed final epoch 20 after 50,000 additional AdamW updates, two datasets and two input conditions. Formal evidence supports this qualified single run; no seed stability, general robustness, new-module efficacy, or target attainment is established.

20x20,000=400,000 sampled tuples; microbatch4xaccumulation2 gives effective batch8 and 100,000 microbatches. YAML provides2 templates+3 search images per tuple:800,000 template and 1,200,000 search sample positions, with 300,000 search-specific model/head passes by source control flow. These are derived logical budgets, not unique frames or measured FLOPs. Matching tuples/update budgets does not equal dual-view compute or prove identical sampled input histories.

Logged task_c/loss is the last accumulation microbatch, not an average over both. Formal training elapsed54,309.54099178314 s; complete/Miss evaluation elapsed6,560.437170743942/5,529.748396873474 s. These receipts do not establish a paired speed comparison.

All five complete metrics are below E0. All five Miss metrics are below original E0; relative to availability, NPR is+0.192448133999072 pp while the other four decrease. Four strict Miss thresholds are unmet. Continued complete-only training can also produce degradation in this run, but the observation does not identify BN, optimizer, masks or KD as the cause of any other model result.

Parent BN metadata shows36 unchanged head buffers and fusion count 37,500->337,500 (+300,000); this matches expected source call counts and does not establish a performance mechanism. E2 final metrics were unavailable at the sealed cutoff. Control-flow or BN preparation checks are not model-gain evidence.

Prior Test diagnostics informed research; historical E0 exposure to val 97 is unresolved and no independently fixed RGBT234 development protocol is provided. Do not describe those data as fully unseen or use the four external targets as certified cross-paper protocol equivalence.

F.name: Evaluation type classification
details: Closed FT, original E0 and availability baseline evaluations are real_gt single-target OPE using external dataset annotations, complete initialization and the disclosed missing-mask protocol.

The audit reruns only CPU arithmetic on saved boxes/GT; it performs no neural forward, training, GPU/process query, network call or dependency installation. Historical CPU stubs/control-flow checks are implementation evidence (simulation/control-flow only), not a separate real-data efficacy experiment.
